maddeler.e:
نتشاعر (form VI)
# نَتَشَاعَرُ (natašāʕaru) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# نَتَشَاعَرَ (natašāʕara) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# نَتَشَاعَرْ (natašāʕar) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʕar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
